summary.answer: HMH kit counts are requests against current inventory space. The reused insertion first merges matching stacks across the entire items array, then tries a supplied blank slot, then ordinary capacity slots unless an explicit special slot14/15/16 is now occupied. A request can be partly accepted and leave remainder; one supplied object can name only the latest merged/filled network ID, not every installed record. Supplied gun state, installed record fields/cache, array slot and slot-derived network key have separate lifetimes. Attachment/cosmetic completion exists only in the completed explicit-blank arm. These are conditional recovered-source links, with no native success or original-PS4 proof.

summary.answer: The reused helper returns the first current array index whose record has the requested network ID. That index is a position, not an item-definition ID, a lasting record identity or a native gadget slot. Health equip uses it only for a below-capacity move into inventory slot10. Debit and removal use fresh ID scans instead of carrying that index. A swap/reset/refill can change both occupancy and network ID, so neither an old index nor an old numeric key proves the same item is still present.

summary.answer: The HMH giver requests attachment objects, and successful add-helper paths append those actual objects to the gun and request a rebuild. Rebuild starts from the entry weapon, combines its base attachment list with each defined attached record var_4c342187, appends the literal string null or custom2 from var_42caf41a, calls getweapon and function_1242e467, then writes item.var_627c698b. The getter returns an existing defined cache before examining current attachment state. Missing base returns before a cache write; direct mutation and failed adds therefore do not prove cache invalidation or a successful gun. The later explicit equip edge rewrites the flag and rebuilds again, with its slotid uncertainty retained. This is a conditional recovered-source link only.
unknowns: No guarantee that each requested _get_item result, compatibility name, attachment add, clip-size lookup, world grant or later equip succeeds. World grant and whole equip logic remain frozen boundaries owned elsewhere.
A defined cache is not a demonstrated current weapon: missing base preserves earlier cache, skipped rebuild leaves it unchanged, and later opaque errors have no proved recovery.
Neither duplicate native options nor idempotent rebuilds are proved. The source has no local name/options deduplication, but actual base-array aliasing and getweapon normalization are unknown.
The literal equip slotid write precedes its later lookup assignment. No substitution of destination var_68dc9720 or inference of null/custom2 meaning is made.

summary.answer: The resolver finds the first current inventory record with a strict-equal network ID; it does not establish a lasting object identity or an item-definition match. Health equip and debit use different snapshots: equip retains a selected item argument, while debit passes a captured numeric ID into a later scan. Slot moves, removal, refill and reset can separate those snapshots. The connection preserves conditional stale/duplicate/reused-ID cases without claiming a real race or native outcome.
